description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for handling chunk-based file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and searching chunks within a file, with references to hash and chunk structures.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a chunkfile structure for either reading or writing based on provided hashfile.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a chunkfile.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in a chunkfile.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a chunk to the chunkfile with specified id, size, and write function.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes all chunks in the chunkfile to the associated file.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads the table of contents from a memory-mapped file to initialize chunk positions.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Finds a chunk by id in the chunkfile and provides its start position and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads a specific chunk by id and processes it with a callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the object ID algorithm used.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
